name: Escorting Erland
summary: Trapped indoors by aggressive prowling predators, Deathstalker Erland requires an escort through Silverpine Forest to regroup with his partner. Assisting him safely across the wilderness delivers him directly to Deathstalker Rane Yorick.

sections.title: Cornered by Wolves
sections.body: Even seasoned scouts of the Forsaken occasionally find themselves outmatched by the unforgiving ecology of Silverpine Forest. Deathstalker Erland finds himself cornered inside a dilapidated shelter, surrounded by starved wolves eager to pick at what little flesh remains on his withered frame. Alone, breaking through their pack is suicide.

sections.title: A Treacherous Crossing
sections.body: Erland's objective lies near the Ivar Patch, where his partner Deathstalker Rane Yorick maintains watch. The route cuts directly through predatory wolf territory. Once guided through the prowlers, Erland sprints the final stretch to reach the safety of Rane Yorick's outpost, where the scouts can consolidate their intelligence for the Undercity.

faq.q: Why are the wolves hunting an undead scout?
faq.answer: As Erland dryly observes, the beasts in Silverpine must be desperate with hunger if they view a desiccated Forsaken corpse as a viable meal. The feral wildlife of the forest is notoriously aggressive to anything moving through their territory.

faq.q: Who is Deathstalker Erland reporting to?
faq.answer: Erland is reporting to Deathstalker Rane Yorick, his scouting partner stationed in a nearby farmhouse near the Ivar Patch. Together, they monitor threats in the woods for the Forsaken.
Erland leaves his refuge and heads toward the farm near the Ivar Patch to report to Rane Yorick. After speaking with Rane, he goes inside and upstairs to check on the injured Quinn Yorick.

faq.q: What happens after Erland is rescued?
faq.answer: Once Erland is safely reunited with Rane Yorick, the two scouts prepare their findings. Rane Yorick subsequently entrusts you with carrying their compiled dispatch back to the Sepulcher in the quest 'The Deathstalkers' Report'.

faq.q: Are there other threats encountered during the escort?
faq.answer: The primary danger comes from the packs of wolves patrolling the open ground between Erland's starting location and the farm near the Ivar Patch.

faq.q: What role do Deathstalkers play in Silverpine?
faq.answer: Deathstalkers serve as the elite rogues, scouts, and assassins of the Forsaken. In Silverpine Forest, they are deployed ahead of main garrisons to track Scourge stragglers, Worgen incursions, feral beasts, and Alliance movements.

angles.text: Forsaken Deathstalkers rely heavily on teamwork and stealth; finding an operative pinned down by simple beasts highlights just how dangerous Silverpine's wilds can be for the newly risen.
Aiding isolated Deathstalkers secures crucial forward reconnaissance for Horde forces pushing outward from the Sepulcher.
